messages.text: Hi! I'm teacher Max. So nice to see you! What is your name?[STUDENT_TALK]
Hi Xiao Ming! What a lovely name! Are you happy today?[STUDENT_TALK]
Wow! You are happy! Are you ready for today's lesson?[STUDENT_TALK]
Wow, you are 7! 7 is a great age! Are you ready for today's lesson?[STUDENT_TALK]
